name: memory-bank
description: Bridge to ZCode's built-in file-based memory: MCP tools and commands write frontmatter memory files into the native memories/ store (auto-extraction, semantic recall and dream consolidation apply), plus pin registry and SessionStart hook for deterministic injection.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 对接 ZCode 原生记忆系统的 Memory Bank：MCP/命令按原生格式写入 memories 目录（自动抽取、语义召回、dream 整理全部生效），pin 注册表 + SessionStart hook 确定性注入。
